# NarcoScope

> A research interface for aggregate public drug-market data, with source provenance and explicit official or illustrative data labels.

NarcoScope covers retail prices, seizures, precursor flows, overdose mortality, wastewater measurements, wildlife confiscation records, and sanctions designations. The interface is for awareness, education, and research.

## Data sources

- UNODC World Drug Report and statistical annexes
- International Narcotics Control Board precursor reports
- European Union Drugs Agency datasets
- CDC provisional overdose mortality
- Statistics Canada wastewater measurements
- US Treasury OFAC sanctions designations
- World Bank GDP per capita

## Limits

NarcoScope does not provide point-of-sale, real-time, sub-street, or navigable location data. Some precursor-price and regional flow records remain illustrative and are labelled in the interface. A designation is a published government action, not a finding of guilt.
